definitions.explanation: A joke or comedic routine, especially a physical or visual gag. Often used for comedy routines and humorous scenes in manga and anime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ギャグ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧。

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ギャグ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧シリアス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧、⟦{読|よ}んでいて→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: That manga has a good balance of comedy and seriousness, so it never gets boring.

notes:
ギャグ (from English "gag") refers to a joke or comedic bit, especially physical comedy, visual humor, or punchlines. Particularly associated with manga and variety shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ギャグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to tell a joke
- ギャグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧: to crack jokes (casual)
- ギャグ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: comedy manga
- ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ギャグ: a lame/unfunny joke
- ギャグ⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧: sense of humor (for jokes)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
ギャグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ (literally "the gag is cold") means a joke falls flat or is unfunny. ⟦{滑|すべ}る→滑る：01230_suberu⟧ is also used: ギャグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}った→滑る：01230_suberu⟧ (the joke bombed).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧: joke (more general, verbal)
- ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧: the funny-man role in comedy (sets up the punchline)
- ⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧: material, bit (comedy routine content)
